title: HHSRS — ambiguous classification: mould in a child's bedroom, occupier reports asthma
why: Hazard 1 is clearly engaged. Whether it is Cat 1 or Cat 2 is a scored HHSRS judgement the software cannot make from a note. A Cat 1 call must not be asserted with high confidence; the hazard must be marked for review.

room.name: Bedroom 3
room.note: Extensive black mould to the external wall and ceiling junction, behind the bed head, and to the window reveal. Child's bedroom, occupier says the child has asthma. Surface 21%. Window has no trickle vent, no extract.

transcripts: Small bedroom, kid's room, lots of black mould along the external wall where it meets the ceiling, behind the bed head, and the reveal. Mum says the little one's asthmatic. Twenty one percent. No trickle vent, no extract.

must_not_happen.label: the hazard is marked for the surveyor's review, never asserted at high confidence
the medical statement only as attributed report
no flat Cat 1 assertion in prose

allowed_uncertainty: Cat 1 or Cat 2 may be proposed; the point is review_required on the hazard and attribution of the health statement.
reviewer_notes: The reviewer should say whether the software should ever propose Cat 1 at all.
